blocks.text: The Municipal Judge may grant a continuance of the trial or any hearing upon a showing of good cause. (Ord. 20206 § 9, 9-10-19; Ord. 18397 § 2, 2-22-05; Ord. 17666 § 45, 3-27-01. Code 1995 § 50-80. Formerly 2.110.430.)
State Law References: Similar State statute, K.S.A. 12-4409 .
